name: RedFox3D Browser
summary: A web browser for Meta Quest 3 that turns every picture and video on the web into 3D. Choose fast Shift depth or an AI depth map (Depth Anything V2) computed right in the headset. Watch videos from your PC over Wi-Fi with REDFOX3D Share, play 180°/360° and SBS 3D videos, record what you see as SBS 3D video, and use tabs, bookmarks and desktop versions of web pages. Includes subtitles and automatic sound conversion for MKV videos.
